questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'A place where birds are kept'
questions.x: 'Aviary' means a place where birds are kept.

questions.q: Choose the one word that can be substituted for: 'A place where bees are kept'
questions.x: 'Apiary' means a place where bees are kept.

questions.q: Select the synonym of the word 'Novice'.
questions.x: 'Novice' means beginner. 'Expert' is close to its opposite; the others are unrelated or look-alike words.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: NOVICE
questions.x: 'Novice' is the opposite of 'Veteran'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Novice'.

questions.q: Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to: GENEROUS
questions.x: 'Generous' is the opposite of 'Mean'. The other options are similar in meaning to 'Generous'.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To get the sack' mean?
o: To be dismissed from a job
questions.x: 'To get the sack' means: to be dismissed from a job.

questions.q: The training session will begin ____ 10 a.m. sharp.
questions.x: 'At' is used with clock times.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
The manager along with his assistants / are visiting / the branch office today.
o: The manager along with his assistants
questions.x: The error is in part (b): 'are visiting'. The subject is 'the manager' (singular); 'along with' does not make it plural: 'is visiting'.

questions.q: What does the phrase 'To keep one's fingers crossed' mean?
o: To hope for a good outcome
questions.x: 'To keep one's fingers crossed' means: to hope for a good outcome.

questions.q:
Identify the segment of the sentence that contains a grammatical error. If the sentence is correct, choose 'No error'.
She has been working / in this department / since five years.
questions.x: The error is in part (c): 'since five years'. Use 'for five years' — 'since' is used with a point of time.

questions.q: According to the passage, why is a pension called 'deferred wages'?
o: It is a gift from the employer
It is paid only to senior officers
It is paid before the work is done
Part of present earnings is set aside to be received later
questions.x: Answer: 'Part of present earnings is set aside to be received later'. The passage says a part of monthly earnings is set aside to be enjoyed decades later. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: A pension is often described as deferred wages. Every month, a small part of what a worker earns is set aside so that, decades later, the worker is not forced to depend on the goodwill of others. The idea is simple, yet its success depends on discipline from three sides: the employer must deposit contributions on time, the fund manager must invest prudently, and the worker must resist the temptation to withdraw savings for every passing need. When any one of them falters, the promise of a dignified old age weakens.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as necessary for a pension system to succeed?
questions.x: Answer: 'Government guarantee of high returns'. The passage lists discipline from employers, fund managers and workers; it does not mention government guarantees. The other options either add ideas not found in the passage or contradict it.
questions.p: A pension is often described as deferred wages. Every month, a small part of what a worker earns is set aside so that, decades later, the worker is not forced to depend on the goodwill of others. The idea is simple, yet its success depends on discipline from three sides: the employer must deposit contributions on time, the fund manager must invest prudently, and the worker must resist the temptation to withdraw savings for every passing need. When any one of them falters, the promise of a dignified old age weakens.

questions.q: The Simon Commission arrived in India — this happened in the year:
questions.x: The Simon Commission arrived in India in 1928. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: Velu Thampi Dalawa led a revolt against the British in:
questions.x: His Kundara Proclamation (1809) called on people to rise against the British.

questions.q: The INA trials of 1945 were held at:
questions.x: Correct answer: The Red Fort, Delhi. Defence counsel included Bhulabhai Desai and Nehru.

questions.q: Who presided over the 1885 session of the Indian National Congress held at Bombay?
questions.x: W. C. Bonnerjee presided over the 1885 Bombay session — the first session, attended by 72 delegates.

questions.q:
In which year did the following take place?
The Bardoli Satyagraha led by Vallabhbhai Patel took place.
questions.x: The Bardoli Satyagraha led by Vallabhbhai Patel took place in 1928. Fix this date on your 1857–1947 timeline along with the events immediately before and after it.

questions.q: Who founded the Ramakrishna Mission (1897)?
questions.x: The Ramakrishna Mission (1897) was founded by Swami Vivekananda.

questions.q: Who presided over the 1907 session of the Indian National Congress held at Surat?
questions.x: Rash Behari Ghosh presided over the 1907 Surat session — the session where the Congress split into Moderates and Extremists.

questions.q: The 'Black Act' against which Gandhi led satyagraha in South Africa required:
o: Registration and fingerprinting of Indians in Transvaal
questions.x: The Asiatic Registration Act (1907) was opposed through passive resistance.

questions.q: Gandhi returned to India from South Africa in:
questions.x: He arrived in Bombay on 9 January 1915 — now observed as Pravasi Bharatiya Divas.

questions.q: The newspaper/journal 'Sambad Kaumudi' is associated with:
o: Sisir Kumar Ghosh and Motilal Ghosh
questions.x: 'Sambad Kaumudi' was started/edited by Raja Ram Mohan Roy.

questions.q: The new Parliament building in New Delhi was inaugurated on:
questions.x: Parliament moved to the new building during the special session in September 2023.

questions.q: The National Education Policy 2020 replaced the 10+2 structure with:
questions.x: It covers ages 3–18 in foundational, preparatory, middle and secondary stages.

questions.q: National Science Day (discovery of the Raman effect) is observed on:
questions.x: National Science Day (discovery of the Raman effect): 28 February.

questions.q: Neeraj Chopra crossed the 90-metre mark for the first time in his career in 2025 at the:
questions.x: Correct answer: Doha Diamond League. He threw 90.23 m in May 2025.

questions.q: Which country hosted the 2024 Summer Olympic and Paralympic Games?
questions.x: Correct answer: France. Paris hosted the Games for the third time.

questions.q: In 2025, Mizoram was declared fully literate under which programme?
questions.x: Correct answer: ULLAS – Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram. ULLAS is the New India Literacy Programme (2022–27).

questions.q: The military exercise 'Mitra Shakti' is conducted between India and:
questions.x: 'Mitra Shakti' is a bilateral exercise between India and Sri Lanka.

questions.q: Vikram Misri was appointed in 2024 as India's:
questions.x: Correct answer: Foreign Secretary. He succeeded Vinay Mohan Kwatra.

questions.q: The 'India State of Forest Report' is published by:
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network (with Gallup and Oxford Wellbeing Research Centre)
questions.x: 'India State of Forest Report' is brought out by Forest Survey of India.

questions.q: 'Mission Mausam', approved in 2024, is aimed at:
o: Making India 'weather-ready and climate-smart' through advanced weather science
questions.x: Correct answer: Making India 'weather-ready and climate-smart' through advanced weather science. It is implemented by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.

questions.q: A no-confidence motion can be moved only in:
o: The Lok Sabha, with the support of at least 50 members
questions.x: Correct answer: The Lok Sabha, with the support of at least 50 members. It need not state reasons.

questions.q: In December 2023, the Supreme Court upheld the abrogation of special status under which Article?
questions.x: The Constitution Bench upheld the 2019 Presidential Orders and directed restoration of statehood at the earliest and elections.

questions.q: The constitutional amendment that gave constitutional status to urban local bodies (municipalities) was enacted in the year:
questions.x: This was the 74th Amendment Act, 1992.

questions.q: Article 14 of the Constitution of India deals with:
o: Equality before law and equal protection of the laws
Original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court
Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of Fundamental Rights
questions.x: Article 14: Equality before law and equal protection of the laws.

questions.q: "Disqualification on ground of defection" is the subject matter of which Schedule of the Constitution?
questions.x: It is the Tenth Schedule.

questions.q: The high-level committee on simultaneous elections (2023–24) was headed by:
questions.x: Correct answer: Ram Nath Kovind. It recommended simultaneous elections in two phases.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Goods and Services Tax Council"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 279A.

questions.q: Who is known as the 'Father of the Indian Constitution'?
questions.x: As chairman of the Drafting Committee he piloted the draft through the Assembly.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Power of High Courts to issue certain writs"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 226.

questions.q: Which Article of the Constitution of India provides for: "Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, assembly, association, movement, residence and profession"?
questions.x: This subject is dealt with in Article 19.

questions.q: GDP measures the market value of all final goods and services produced:
o: Within the domestic territory of a country in a year
By the citizens of a country anywhere in the world
questions.x: Correct answer: Within the domestic territory of a country in a year. GNP adds net factor income from abroad to GDP.

questions.q: The currency of India is issued by the RBI under the:
questions.x: Correct answer: RBI Act, 1934. Coins are minted by the Government under the Coinage Act, 2011.

questions.q: 'Maharatna' status for a central public sector enterprise is the highest status, conferring:
o: Greater financial and operational autonomy to the board
questions.x: Correct answer: Greater financial and operational autonomy to the board. Navratna and Miniratna are other categories.

questions.q: 'Zaid' crops are grown:
o: Between rabi and kharif seasons in summer
questions.x: Correct answer: Between rabi and kharif seasons in summer. Examples are watermelon, cucumber and fodder crops.

questions.q: The 'per capita income' of a country is a measure of its:
questions.x: Correct answer: Average income per person. It does not reveal distribution.

questions.q: SEBI is the regulator of:
questions.x: Correct answer: Securities markets in India. It was set up in 1988 and given statutory powers in 1992.

questions.q: A consumer price index rose from 190.4 to 199.9 over a year. The inflation rate (rounded to one decimal) is:
questions.x: Inflation = (New index − Old index)/Old index × 100 = (199.9 − 190.4)/190.4 × 100 ≈ 5%.

questions.q: CPI (Combined) used for inflation targeting is released by the:
questions.x: Its base year is 2012 = 100 (a revision to a newer base is under way).

questions.q: 'Cess' and 'surcharge' levied by the Centre are significant because they:
o: Are not part of the divisible pool shared with States
questions.x: Correct answer: Are not part of the divisible pool shared with States. This has been a point of Centre–State fiscal debate.

questions.q: Who issues one-rupee notes in India?
o: The Ministry of Finance (Government of India)
The Security Printing Corporation on its own
questions.x: One-rupee notes carry the signature of the Finance Secretary; other notes are issued by the RBI.

questions.q: Amortisation refers to the systematic write-off of:
o: Intangible assets such as patents and goodwill (where applicable)
questions.x: Depreciation applies to tangible fixed assets; amortisation to intangibles.

questions.q: The document sent by a buyer to the seller when returning goods is a:
questions.x: The buyer debits the supplier's account and sends a debit note.

questions.q: Two errors that cancel each other's effect on the trial balance are called:
questions.x: E.g., Wages account overcast by ₹100 and Rent account undercast by ₹100 — the errors offset each other.

questions.q: A business has total assets of ₹8,20,000 and outside liabilities of ₹25,000. Its capital (owner's equity) is:
questions.x: Assets = Liabilities + Capital → Capital = 8,20,000 − 25,000 = ₹7,95,000.

questions.q: Fixed costs are ₹72,000, selling price is ₹190 per unit and variable cost is ₹160 per unit. The break-even point in units is:
questions.x:
Contribution per unit = 190 − 160 = ₹30.
BEP (units) = Fixed cost / Contribution per unit = 72,000 / 30 = 2,400 units.

questions.q: A firm has Cash ₹40,000, Debtors ₹50,000, Inventory ₹30,000, Prepaid expenses ₹7,500, Creditors ₹40,000, Bills payable ₹12,500 and Outstanding expenses ₹7,500. Its current ratio is:
A generator set is purchased for ₹3,95,000. Its estimated useful life is 8 years with a residual value of ₹14,000. Annual depreciation under the Straight Line Method is:
questions.x:
SLM depreciation = (Cost + installation − residual value) / useful life.
= (3,95,000 − 14,000) / 8 = 3,81,000 / 8 = ₹47,625 per year.
Installation is capitalised as part of cost (AS 10 / Ind AS 16).

questions.q: Vouching in auditing means:
o: Examining documentary evidence supporting entries in the books
questions.x: Correct answer: Examining documentary evidence supporting entries in the books. Vouching checks authenticity of transactions.

questions.q: Machinery costing ₹2,80,000 is depreciated at 20% per annum on the Written Down Value method. Its book value at the end of 2 years will be:
questions.x:
WDV: depreciation each year is charged on the opening book value.
Book value = Cost × (1 − r)ⁿ = 2,80,000 × (0.8)^2 = ₹1,79,200.
(SLM at the same rate would give ₹1,68,000.)

questions.q: The Income and Expenditure Account of a not-for-profit organisation is prepared on:
o: Accrual basis, including only revenue items of the current year
questions.x: Correct answer: Accrual basis, including only revenue items of the current year. It is equivalent to a P&L account; surplus/deficit is the result.

questions.q: Which of the following is debited to the Trading Account?
questions.x: Carriage inwards is a direct expense; carriage outwards is a selling expense in the P&L account.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): Land is generally not depreciated.
Reason (R): Land has an indefinite useful life.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: Correct answer: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A. A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. R explains A.

questions.q: P and Q share profits in the ratio 4 : 3. They admit R for a 1/6 share, which R acquires from P and Q in their existing ratio. The new profit-sharing ratio of P, Q and R is:
Purchases during a month: 1st — 300 units @ ₹12; 10th — 300 units @ ₹14; 20th — 150 units @ ₹15. 350 units were issued on the 25th. Value of closing stock under FIFO is:
questions.x: Under FIFO the earliest units are issued first, so the 400 units left come from the latest purchases: 150 × ₹15 + 250 × ₹14 = ₹5,750.

questions.q: A laid-off worker's basic + DA is ₹600 per day and the worker is laid off for 10 working days. Lay-off compensation under the IR Code is:
questions.x: Lay-off compensation = 50% of basic + DA = ₹300/day × 10 days = ₹3,000.

questions.q: Under the OSH Code, overtime work requires:
o: Only a verbal instruction from the supervisor
The consent of the worker and payment at twice the ordinary rate
questions.x: Overtime is permitted only with the worker's consent and is paid at twice the ordinary rate of wages.

questions.q: Under the IR Code, no person employed in an industrial establishment shall go on strike without giving notice within how many days before striking?
questions.x: Section 62: strike notice must be given within sixty days before striking, and the strike cannot take place within fourteen days of giving notice.

questions.q: A landmark 2019 judgment held that special allowances paid universally, necessarily and ordinarily to all employees form part of 'basic wages' for EPF contributions. The case is:
o: Bridge and Roof Co. v. Union of India (1963)
Manipal Academy of Higher Education v. PF Commissioner (2008)
Regional PF Commissioner (II), West Bengal v. Vivekananda Vidyamandir (2019)
questions.x: The Court applied the universality test: allowances paid to all employees cannot be excluded from basic wages to reduce PF liability.

questions.q: To be eligible for statutory bonus, an employee must have worked in the establishment for at least how many days in the accounting year?
questions.x: Section 26(1): an employee who has worked not less than thirty days in the accounting year is eligible.

questions.q: The Beedi and Cigar Workers (Conditions of Employment) Act was enacted in:
questions.x: It regulated welfare, hours and licensing of beedi industrial premises; now part of the OSH Code.

questions.q: The ILO is a specialised agency of:
questions.x: Correct answer: The United Nations. The ILO became the first specialised agency of the UN in 1946.

questions.q: The Equal Remuneration Act, 1976 was enacted in the backdrop of which international development?
questions.x: The Act followed the International Women's Year (1975) and India's ratification of ILO Convention 100 on equal remuneration.

questions.q: An audio-visual worker under the OSH Code is a person employed in:
o: Production of films, television programmes or digital content
A sound-recording studio only as a cleaner
questions.x: The Code widens 'cine workers' to audio-visual workers, covering films, TV, web series and other digital production.

questions.q: Labour as a subject of legislation in India falls primarily under which part of the Seventh Schedule?
questions.x: Trade unions, industrial disputes, social security and welfare of labour are Entries 22–24 of the Concurrent List, which is why both the Centre and States frame rules under the Codes.

questions.q:
Consider the following:
Assertion (A): The Code on Wages makes the principal employer liable for wages of contract workers if the contractor defaults.
Reason (R): This provision protects workers from non-payment due to insolvency or absconding contractors.
Select the correct answer:
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.x: A is true and R is true; R correctly explains A. Both are true and R explains the purpose of A.

questions.q: The salary ceiling for eligibility to bonus has historically been revised; under the 2015 amendment to the bonus law it was raised to:
questions.x: The Payment of Bonus (Amendment) Act, 2015 raised the eligibility ceiling from ₹10,000 to ₹21,000 per month and the calculation ceiling from ₹3,500 to ₹7,000 (or the minimum wage).

questions.q: The apex tripartite decision-making body of the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation is the:
questions.x: The CBT administers the EPF, EPS and EDLI schemes; the ESI Corporation governs ESIC.

questions.q: The 'demographic dividend' refers to the economic growth potential arising from:
o: A large share of working-age population relative to dependants
questions.x: India's large working-age population (15–64) offers a dividend if adequately employed and skilled.

questions.q: Which mechanism involves a neutral third party who helps the disputing parties reach their own agreement but does not impose a decision?
questions.x: Conciliation is facilitative. In arbitration and adjudication, the third party gives a binding decision.

questions.q: How many types of disabilities are recognised under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016?
questions.x: The 2016 Act expanded the list from 7 to 21 specified disabilities, including acid attack victims and specific learning disabilities.

questions.q: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) provides accident cover of ₹2 lakh for an annual premium of:
questions.x: The premium was revised from ₹12 to ₹20 in June 2022; partial disability cover is ₹1 lakh.

questions.q: The normal age of superannuation for drawing EPS pension is:
questions.x: Members can draw full pension at 58; early pension is possible from 50 at a reduced rate.

questions.q: The chief executive officer of EPFO is designated as:
questions.x: Correct answer: Central Provident Fund Commissioner. The CPFC heads EPFO; ESIC is headed by a Director General.

questions.q: The National Pension System (NPS) became mandatory for new Central Government employees (except armed forces) joining on or after:
questions.x: NPS replaced the defined-benefit old pension scheme for new central government recruits from 1 January 2004.

questions.q: EPFO began investing a part of its incremental deposits in Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) in:
questions.x: EPFO started with 5% of incremental deposits in ETFs in 2015, later raised to a band of 5–15%.

questions.q: A 'pay-as-you-go' (PAYG) pension system means:
o: Each worker's contributions are invested for his or her own pension
Current workers' contributions pay current pensioners' benefits
Pensions are paid only on demand
questions.x: PAYG systems are sensitive to the ratio of workers to pensioners (dependency ratio).

questions.q: 'Social audit' under MGNREGA is conducted by:
questions.x: Section 17 requires Gram Sabhas to conduct regular social audits of works.

questions.q: The Payment of Gratuity Act was enacted in:
questions.x: The 1972 Act is now subsumed in the Code on Social Security, 2020.

questions.q: Under the Employees' Pension Scheme, 1995, a member retires at 58 with pensionable salary of ₹15,000 and pensionable service of 13 years (including any weightage). The monthly member pension is:
questions.x:
Monthly pension = (Pensionable salary × Pensionable service) / 70
= (15,000 × 13) / 70 = ₹2,786.
Pensionable salary is the average of the last 60 months' wages (subject to the ₹15,000 ceiling), and the minimum pension is ₹1,000.

questions.q: The 'Career Centres' under the Code on Social Security replace:
questions.x: Correct answer: Employment exchanges. Employers must notify vacancies to career centres.

questions.q: An employee's monthly basic wages plus DA are ₹8,500. Of the employer's 12% contribution, how much is credited to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS) account?
questions.x:
Employer's 12% = ₹1,020. Of this, 8.33% of wages (on a wage ceiling of ₹15,000) goes to EPS: 8.33% × 8,500 = ₹708.
The balance ₹312 (3.67%) goes to the EPF account. The employee's own 12% (₹1,020) goes entirely to EPF.

questions.q: The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) is chaired by:
o: The Union Minister for Labour and Employment
questions.x: The Labour Minister chairs the ESI Corporation; the Director General is the chief executive.

questions.q: The most abundant gas in the Earth's atmosphere is:
questions.x: Nitrogen ≈ 78%, oxygen ≈ 21%, argon ≈ 0.9%.

questions.q: Body Mass Index (BMI) is calculated as:
questions.x: Correct answer: Weight (kg) ÷ height² (m²). A BMI of 18.5–24.9 is generally considered normal.

questions.q: The 'brain' of a computer is the:
questions.x: The CPU executes instructions; it contains the ALU, control unit and registers.

questions.q: Telephone (patent) is credited to:
questions.x: Telephone (patent): Alexander Graham Bell.

questions.q: Rickets is caused by the deficiency of:
questions.x: Rickets results from lack of Vitamin D.

questions.q: Household electricity supply in India is:
questions.x: Correct answer: AC at 220–230 V and 50 Hz. The US uses 110–120 V at 60 Hz.

questions.q: 'Cloud computing' refers to:
o: Computing using clouds of data only
Delivery of computing services such as storage and software over the internet
questions.x: Correct answer: Delivery of computing services such as storage and software over the internet. Models include IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.

questions.q: NaHCO₃ (sodium hydrogen carbonate) is commonly known as:
questions.x: NaHCO₃ (sodium hydrogen carbonate) is baking soda.

questions.q: The 'Kelvin' is the SI unit of:
questions.x: Kelvin measures thermodynamic temperature.

questions.q: Acid rain is mainly caused by emissions of:
questions.x: It damages buildings (e.g., the Taj Mahal's 'marble cancer') and ecosystems.

questions.q: In computing, 'LAN' stands for:
questions.x: LAN = Local Area Network.

questions.q: In MS Excel, a chart type best suited to show parts of a whole is:
questions.x: Correct answer: Pie chart. Line charts show trends over time.

questions.q: Two inlet pipes can fill a reservoir in 4 hours and 20 hours respectively, while an outlet pipe can empty the full tank in 10 hours. If all three are opened together on an empty tank, it will be full in:
questions.x:
Take tank capacity = LCM(4, 20, 10) = 20 units.
Rates: +5, +1, −2 units/hour → net 4 units/hour.
Time = 20 / 4 = 5 hours.

questions.q: Three bells toll at intervals of 10, 6, 16 seconds respectively. If they start together, after how long will they next coincide?
questions.x:
They coincide after LCM(10, 6, 16) seconds.
LCM = 240 s = 4 min.

questions.q: The absentee counts of a unit are: 26, 41, 80, 36, 11, 28, 29. Their arithmetic mean is:
questions.x: Sum = 251; number of values = 7. Mean = 251/7 = 35.86.

questions.q: Find the next term of the series: 31, 34, 39, 46, 55, ?
questions.x: Differences are 3, 5, 7, 9 — increasing by 2. Next difference = 11, so next term = 55 + 11 = 66.

questions.q: A surveyor starts from point O and walks 13 km towards South, then turns right and walks 10 km, then turns right and walks 10 km, and finally turns right and walks 14 km. How far is the person from O and in which direction?
questions.x:
Take O as origin, North/East positive.
North–South: -13 +10 = -3 km → 3 km South.
East–West: -10 +14 = 4 km → 4 km East.
Distance = √(4² + 3²) = 5 km, towards South-East.

questions.q: In a certain code language, DEPOT is written as BCNMR. How is HEALTH written in that code?
questions.x:
Compare DEPOT → BCNMR: D→B, E→C, P→N…
Rule: each letter is moved 2 places backward in the alphabet.
Applying it to HEALTH gives FCYJRF.

questions.q: A train 260 m long running at 72 km/h crosses a platform in 40 seconds. The length of the platform is:
questions.x:
Speed = 72 × 5/18 = 20 m/s. Distance covered in 40 s = 800 m = train + platform.
Platform = 800 − 260 = 540 m.

questions.q: A number when divided by 90 leaves a remainder of 63. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 15?
questions.x: N = 90k + 63. Since 15 divides 90, the remainder is simply 63 mod 15 = 3.

questions.q: In what ratio must rice costing ₹80 per kg be mixed with rice costing ₹130 per kg so that the mixture is worth ₹103 per kg?
questions.x:
Alligation: (dearer − mean) : (mean − cheaper) = (130 − 103) : (103 − 80) = 27 : 23 = 27 : 23.
This is cheaper : dearer.

questions.q: A courier van travels from town P to town Q at 16 km/h and returns along the same road at 48 km/h. The average speed for the whole journey is:
questions.x:
For equal distances, average speed = 2uv/(u + v) (harmonic mean), not (u + v)/2.
= 2 × 16 × 48 / (16 + 48) = 1536/64 = 24 km/h.

questions.q: ₹32,400 is divided among three branches in the ratio 3 : 7 : 2. The largest share is:
questions.x:
Sum of ratio terms = 3 + 7 + 2 = 12.
One part = 32,400 / 12 = ₹2,700.
Largest share = 7 × 2,700 = ₹18,900.

questions.q: A and B start a business investing ₹35,000 and ₹35,000 for a year. Out of a profit of ₹2,200, B gets:
questions.x:
Profit is shared in the ratio of capital × time.
A: 35,000×12, B: 35,000×12 → 1 : 1.
B's share = 1/2 × 2,200 = ₹1,100.

questions.q: Find the compound interest on ₹8,000 for 2 years at 5% per annum, compounded annually.
questions.x:
Amount = P(1 + R/100)² = 8,000 × (1.05)² = ₹8,820.
CI = Amount − P = ₹820.
Check: SI for 2 years = ₹800; CI exceeds it by P(R/100)² = ₹20.

questions.q: Team X can paint a hall in 36 days and Team Y can do it in 45 days. Working together, they will finish it in:
questions.x:
One day's work: 1/36 + 1/45 = 81/1620 = 1/20.
Together they need 20 days. (Product/Sum: 36×45/(36+45) = 20.)
